subject: Deep dive scheduling manifest / rotating availability proposal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Sam Wu <sam.wu@healthlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deep dive scheduling manifest / rotating availability proposal

Hi Priya — thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the deep dive:

- Recap: Healthlytics is focused on latency-sensitive inference for patient-triage models, multi-tenant encryption at-rest, and an audit-grade logging requirement for 18 months. Sam indicated they'd want to validate cost/latency tradeoffs on a small pilot and evaluate private deployment options.

- Proposed deep-dive scope (90 min): 1) 15-min architecture recap; 2) 40-min technical demo (live model run + perf profile); 3) 20-min ops Q&A (security/KMS, logging, retention); 4) 15-min next steps & pilot plan.

- Scheduling ask: To make this practical for your distributed team, we suggest running a 3-week "rotational pilot" of candidate deep-dive slots so we can converge on a steady recurring window. The pilot pattern we propose: each week we offer one region-favored slot (US / EU / APAC) and rotate so the burden is shared. Sample window definitions (all UTC for clarity):

  * EU-friendly window: Tue 07:00 - 09:00 UTC (09:00 - 11:00 CEST)
  * US-friendly window: Wed 16:00 - 18:00 UTC (09:00 - 11:00 PDT)
  * APAC-friendly window: Thu 00:00 - 02:00 UTC (09:00 - 11:00 JST/AWST)

These are just candidate windows — for the first deep dive we can pick the EU-friendly slot since Sam mentioned EU mornings work best for him. To move this forward, could you confirm: 1) which date next week works for you in the EU window; 2) who will join from your side (names + roles); 3) any demo data constraints (sample data vs. synthetic)?

I've attached a short "deep-dive ops checklist" (ops checklist + availability grid) to make invites and prerequisites easier. If that looks good I'll propose two concrete UTC slots and Karthik can send invites.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
(attachment: deep-dive-ops-checklist.pdf)

From: Priya Shah <priya@healthlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Wu <sam.wu@healthlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 22:48:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Deep dive scheduling manifest / rotating availability proposal

Thanks for the clear recap, Soojin — great to meet the team earlier. A few quick notes:

- Scope: the 90-min agenda looks perfect. We definitely want Sam (CTO) and Xavier Liao (Head of Data Infrastructure) in the session.

- Constraints: Sam's preferred windows are Tue/Thu mornings CEST (roughly 08:30–11:30 CEST). Priya (me) can be more flexible and can join later EU afternoons if needed. Our APAC engineers do not need to attend the first run — they can join a recording.

- Desired date: Tue May 4 works well for us if you're able to do 09:00–10:30 CEST (that maps to Tue May 4, 07:00–08:30 UTC). If you prefer a US-friendly fallback, Wed May 5 in your afternoon window could work for internal alignment.

I'll wait for a concrete calendar invite. Also please share any pre-read or sample logs you want us to review ahead of time.

Best,
Priya Shah
Director of Product, Healthlytics Inc.
priya@healthlytics.com
(attachment: n/a)

Thanks Priya — happy to lock this. Per Soojin's note and Priya's preference, proposing two concrete UTC options for the first session (please pick one):

Option 1 (EU-friendly - preferred per Priya): Tue May 4, 2026 07:00 - 08:30 UTC (09:00 - 10:30 CEST) — aligns with Sam's Tue morning window.
Option 2 (US-friendly fallback): Wed May 5, 2026 16:00 - 17:30 UTC (09:00 - 10:30 PDT) — in case we need a US-friendly pilot.

Notes: 1) We'll run the full 90-min agenda and share a recording + notes. 2) Attached are the deep-dive-ops-checklist.pdf and a compact timezone-availability-grid.csv showing participant availability across zones. 3) If you confirm Option 1, I'll send a calendar invite to Sam, Priya, Xavier, and our demo engineers (Monica + one infra engineer).

Proposed attendees from Redwood (technical):
  - Monica Patel — Solutions Engineer (demo + infra)
  - Javier Ramos — Inference Engineer (perf instrumentation) (will be attached to the invite)

Calendar stub (for accepting): https://calendar.redwood.com/invite/HLT-0034-deepdive (will contain full dial-in and recording link after you accept).

If Option 1 works, please reply 'Option 1 — confirm' and we'll drop the invite.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
